sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: Eatouts ("we", "us", "our") is a restaurant discovery application operated by [Registered Company Name], [Plot/Address], Gaborone, Botswana.
For privacy enquiries contact privacy@eatouts.co.bw.

sections.heading: What this policy covers
paragraphs: This policy explains how we handle information in connection with the Eatouts mobile application and website.

sections.heading: What we do not collect
paragraphs: Eatouts does not require you to create an account to browse.

We do not collect, request, or store: your name, email address, or phone number as a diner; payment card or banking details; your order contents, order history, or basket; your contacts, photos, or messages.

sections.heading: How orders work — the WhatsApp handoff
paragraphs: When you compile an order, it is assembled locally on your device.
When you tap send, your device hands that text to WhatsApp. At that point the message is governed by WhatsApp's own privacy policy and terms, not ours.
We do not receive a copy, cannot read it, and do not store it.
We are not a party to any transaction between you and a restaurant.

sections.heading: Information we do collect
paragraphs: Technical and usage data: device model, operating system, app version, language, general region, screens viewed, session duration, and crash reports. Used to fix bugs and improve the app.
Approximate location: only if you grant permission, to sort restaurants by distance. You can deny or revoke this in your device settings at any time; the app remains usable.
Restaurant account data: for businesses that claim a listing — business name, contact person, email, phone, password (stored hashed), and any content they upload.
Correspondence: if you email or message our support, we keep that correspondence.

sections.heading: Why we use it
paragraphs: To operate and improve Eatouts, to display relevant nearby restaurants, to maintain accurate listings, to respond to enquiries, to detect misuse, and to comply with law.

sections.heading: Legal basis
paragraphs: Under Botswana's Data Protection Act, 2018, we rely on your consent (location), our legitimate interests (app security, improvement, fraud prevention), and contract (restaurant accounts).

sections.heading: Sharing
paragraphs: We do not sell personal data.
We share limited technical data with service providers who host and support the app, including [Google Firebase / analytics provider / hosting provider], who process it on our instructions.
We may disclose data where required by law or court order.

sections.heading: Retention
paragraphs: Technical and analytics data is retained for up to 24 months.
Restaurant account data is retained while the account is active and for 12 months after closure.
Support correspondence is retained for 24 months.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: We use encryption in transit, hashed passwords, and access controls. No system is perfectly secure, but we take reasonable steps appropriate to the sensitivity of the data we hold.

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: Eatouts is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect their data.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal data we hold about you, and you may object to processing. Email privacy@eatouts.co.bw.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Botswana Data Protection Commissioner.

sections.heading: International transfers
paragraphs: Some service providers may store data outside Botswana. Where this occurs we take steps to ensure appropriate safeguards.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We will post any updated policy in-app with a new version number and date. Material changes will be notified in-app.

sections.heading: Acceptance
paragraphs: By using Eatouts you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the app.

sections.heading: What Eatouts is
paragraphs: Eatouts is a restaurant discovery and menu information platform.
We are not a restaurant, not a delivery service, not a payment processor, and not an agent for any restaurant.
We do not prepare, sell, deliver, or take responsibility for any food or beverage.

sections.heading: Menu and pricing accuracy
paragraphs: Menu items, descriptions, and prices are compiled from information published publicly by restaurants and from content supplied by restaurants themselves.
Prices are shown in Botswana Pula (P) and are indicative only. They may change without notice.
Items marked "Seasonal Price" or "From P—" vary.
The restaurant's own menu and confirmation are authoritative. Always confirm price and availability with the restaurant before ordering.

sections.heading: Orders placed via WhatsApp
paragraphs: Orders are compiled on your device and sent by you, at your choice, through WhatsApp.
Eatouts is not a party to the order or any resulting contract.
Eatouts does not transmit, receive, or store the order.
Eatouts does not guarantee that the restaurant receives, accepts, or fulfils the order.
Eatouts is not liable for delays, errors, omissions, wrong items, quality, portion size, or non-delivery.
Any dispute about an order is between you and the restaurant.

sections.heading: Allergies, dietary and religious requirements
paragraphs: You must confirm all allergen, dietary, and Halal or other certification information directly with the restaurant before ordering.
Eatouts does not independently verify ingredients, preparation methods, cross-contamination risk, or certification.
Do not rely on the app for allergy safety.

sections.heading: Restaurant listings and claiming
paragraphs: Restaurants may claim their listing by submitting a claim request.
We may verify ownership before granting access.
Claimed accounts may edit descriptions, images, contacts, hours, and menus, and may respond to enquiries.
We may reject or revoke a claim, and may suspend an account that breaches these Terms.

sections.heading: Content supplied by restaurants
paragraphs: By uploading content, a restaurant confirms it owns or has the right to use that content and grants Eatouts a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide licence to display, reproduce, and promote it in the app, on our website, and in our marketing.
That licence ends when the content is removed, except for copies already published or cached.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The Eatouts name, design, layout, and code belong to us.
Restaurant names, logos, menu text, and photography belong to their respective owners and are used to identify those businesses or under licence from them.
If you believe content infringes your rights, see clause 10.

sections.heading: Advertising and sponsored placements
paragraphs: Restaurants may pay for promoted placement or advertising.
Paid placements will be clearly labelled as sponsored or promoted.
Payment does not purchase favourable reviews, altered ratings, or inaccurate information.

sections.heading: Takedown and correction requests
paragraphs: If you own a restaurant and want a listing, logo, menu, or image removed or corrected, email legal@eatouts.co.bw with the business name and the specific content.
We aim to action verified requests within 5 business days and will confirm once done.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
paragraphs: You agree not to scrape, bulk-copy, resell, or systematically extract our data; not to submit false claims or impersonate a restaurant; not to upload unlawful, misleading, or infringing content; not to interfere with the app's security or operation; and not to use the app for any unlawful purpose.

sections.heading: Availability
paragraphs: We aim for high availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free service. Features may change or be withdrawn.

sections.heading: Disclaimer
paragraphs: Eatouts is provided "as is" and "as available".
To the fullest extent permitted by law, we disclaim all warranties, express or implied, including accuracy, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the fullest extent permitted by Botswana law, Eatouts is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential loss, loss of profit, or loss arising from any order, meal, restaurant experience, or reliance on listing information.
Where liability cannot be excluded, our total liability is limited to P500.

sections.heading: Indemnity
paragraphs: You agree to indemnify Eatouts against claims arising from your misuse of the app, your breach of these Terms, or content you upload.

sections.heading: Termination
paragraphs: We may suspend or terminate access, or remove any listing, at our discretion, particularly for breach of these Terms or on a valid takedown request.

sections.heading: Governing law
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of Botswana, and the courts of Botswana have exclusive jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may update these Terms. Continued use after an update constitutes acceptance. The current version and date are always shown in Settings.
